predecessors.name: Videha
predecessors.text: the Videha country of the league (the infobox names Videha as the league's predecessor; Maha-Videha established 'Around 800 BCE')

successors.name: Haryanka dynasty
successors.text: 'Licchavi, Videha and Naya were annexed to Magadha'

ledger.x: 600 BCE: the Vajjika League stands at Vesali.
481 BCE: Ajatashatru's second campaign against the league.
468 BCE: Magadha annexes the Vajjika League.

wars.name: Magadha-Vajji war
wars.outcome: Magadha wins: the Vajjika League is defeated and annexed by 468 BCE.

certainty.note: The league's rivers and the Himalaya bound it only loosely; the Malla republics inside it kept sovereign rights and the Licchavi-Videha frontier is not given.
